newsitem.title: UK: BA names Dickerson as general manager Regions.
newsitem.headline: BA names Dickerson as general manager Regions.

text.p: British Airways World Cargo said Keith Dickerson has been appointed general manager, Regions with immediate effect.
Dickerson has a global responsibility for the four regions whose cargo managers will report to him, a company spokesman told Reuters.
He was previously senior vice-president cargo, Americas and is replaced in this role by Pat Roberts, formerly general manager, marketing and UK And Ireland sales who will be based in New York.
Denis Conolly becomes regional cargo manager UK and Europe, based in London. He was formerly general manager Heathrow operations, the spokesman said.

The other two regional managers remain unchanged. Chris Humphrey continues as cargo manager Pacific region based in Hong Kong, with Ray Yates as cargo manager, Southern region based in London. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
